last_quiz.subject: ENGLISH
last_quiz.question: Select the sentence that correctly uses the subjunctive mood.

options.A: If I was you, I would study harder.
options.B: If I were you, I would study harder.
options.C: If I am you, I would study harder.
options.D: If I be you, I would study harder.

last_quiz.explanation: The subjunctive form after ‘if’ for a hypothetical situation uses ‘were’ with all persons: “If I were you…”.
